p: The Home page assembles 10 distinct sections, each handling its own data fetching via Axios and animation via Framer Motion. The Hero section displays an animated gradient background with prominent call-to-action buttons linking to key platform features like crop browsing and product discovery. TextGenerateEffect provides animated headline reveal on page load.

The Stats section displays platform metrics with counting animation triggered when the section scrolls into view, providing social proof through numerical evidence of platform adoption. The Crops carousel auto-scrolls through featured crop cards with manual navigation controls for user interaction.

The Services grid displays platform offerings in a card layout with hover animation effects. The About preview provides a brief platform introduction and mission statement. The Testimonials carousel auto-plays through user feedback with star rating display. The Products showcase displays featured products with category filtering tabs.

The Blog preview shows recent articles in a card layout with read more navigation. The Gallery section displays a filterable media grid organized by category. The Newsletter section collects email subscriptions with client-side validation. Each section uses scroll-triggered whileInView animations for performant entrance effects.

The About page provides the platform mission statement and development timeline, establishing brand identity and trust with visitors. The Crops page fetches and displays all crops in a responsive grid with a detail modal showing complete cultivation information when a crop is selected.

The Products page enables category-based filtering through tab navigation with price display and stock indicators for each product. The Blog page lists articles with keyword search functionality for content discovery. The Gallery page provides category filtering with lightbox image viewing for full-screen media browsing.

The Contact page combines a contact form with form validation and an embedded map display for location information. The FAQ page uses an accordion component for expandable question and answer display. The Login and Register pages have form validation with error state display. The Profile page allows authenticated users to view and edit their personal information.

The Admin layout component provides a private layout shell with sidebar navigation showing active route highlighting, a header displaying the logged-in user information, and a React Router Outlet for sub-page content rendering. Access is controlled by the auth middleware verifying user.role equals admin, with non-admin users redirected to the home page with an error notification.

Admin sub-pages include the Dashboard with statistics cards and 30-day page view trend charts, Manage Crops with a searchable data table and CRUD modal, Manage Products with a similar management pattern and category filtering, Manage Blogs with rich text editor integration for content creation.

Additional sub-pages include Manage Inquiries with submission status tracking and read/unread toggling, Manage Users with complete user listing and account deletion capabilities, and Settings for platform configuration options. All admin actions trigger toast notifications confirming success or displaying error details.

The components/common directory contains 10 reusable UI elements designed for consistent appearance and behavior across the application. The Navbar component implements responsive navigation with a mobile hamburger menu below the lg breakpoint, a theme toggle button for dark and light mode switching, and auth-aware link rendering that shows login or profile based on authentication state. Sticky positioning with glass-morphism background activates on scroll.

The Footer component provides site-wide footer with organized sitemap link sections, social media icon links, and a newsletter subscription form. The Button component supports variant options including primary, secondary, and outline styles with size configurations and a loading state with spinner display.

The Input component includes label and error message display with controlled input pattern support. The Card component provides flexible content container styling. The Modal component implements overlay dialogs with backdrop click-outside close and keyboard escape key support. The Badge component displays color-coded status indicators.

The Spinner component shows loading states with configurable size and color. The Alert component displays notifications with success, error, warning, and info variants with auto-dismiss timer support. The SkeletonLoader component provides animated placeholder content during data fetching for improved perceived performance.

Home-specific components implement the landing page sections with independent data fetching and animation logic. The Hero component features TextGenerateEffect for animated text reveal, gradient background overlay, and call-to-action button integration. The Stats component implements count-up animation triggered on viewport entry for platform metric display.

The CropCarousel provides auto-scrolling behavior with manual navigation arrow controls and featured crop card display. The ServicesGrid renders service cards with hover animation effects, icons, and description text. The AboutSection presents platform information with timeline display and mission presentation.

The TestimonialsCarousel provides auto-playing testimonial rotation with star rating visualization and user review cards. The ProductsShowcase enables category tab filtering with product cards displaying prices. The BlogPreview shows recent blog article cards with read more navigation.

The GallerySection implements filterable media grid with category filter buttons and image thumbnail display. The Newsletter component provides email input with form validation and subscription button. Each section integrates with Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations and consistent animation language.

Admin panel components in components/admin provide the administrative interface functionality. The Sidebar component renders navigation links with active route highlighting and responsive collapsible behavior. The DataTable component provides searchable and sortable tabular data display with pagination controls for large datasets.

The FormModal component handles create and edit operations with form field rendering, validation display, and submit and cancel actions. The StatCard component displays metric visualization with icon, label, value, and optional trend indicator. The Chart component integrates recharts for bar chart visualization of 30-day page view trends.

The ImageUpload component provides file selection with type validation and preview display before upload. The ConfirmDialog component implements destructive action confirmation with action description, warning message, and confirm and cancel options to prevent accidental data loss.

Custom hooks provide reusable logic extracted from components following React hook naming conventions. The useAuth hook wraps AuthContext access and returns user, loading, login, register, and logout values for convenient authentication state management in any component.

The useTheme hook wraps ThemeContext access and returns theme, toggleTheme, and isDark values for consistent theme state access. The useFetch hook handles GET request lifecycle with automatic loading and error state tracking, providing a data fetching abstraction for components.

The useForm hook manages form state with field value management, validation rule configuration, and form submission handling. The useClickOutside hook detects clicks outside a specified element for closing dropdowns and modals, using ref-based outside click detection.

The admin dashboard provides an overview of platform activity with statistics cards displaying key metrics including total crops, products, blogs, and inquiries count. These metrics give administrators a quick visual understanding of the platform content status at a glance.

A 30-day page view trend visualization using recharts bar charts helps administrators identify traffic patterns and popular content. The chart displays daily view counts with per-page breakdown available for detailed content performance analysis.

The sidebar navigation provides access to all management sections with active route visual highlighting. The navigation is responsive with collapsible behavior on smaller screens to maintain usability. The admin header displays the logged-in user information for identity context.

Each management section follows a consistent pattern for administrative efficiency. The Manage Crops section provides a data table with search functionality, pagination controls, and a CRUD modal for creating and editing crop entries with field validation and image upload support.

The Manage Products section mirrors the crops interface with additional category filtering support in the data table. The Manage Blogs section includes a rich text editor for content creation with tag management for categorization and publish status control.

The Manage Inquiries section displays contact form submissions with read and unread status toggle functionality for efficient communication workflow management. The Manage Users section provides complete user listing with role display and account deletion with confirmation.

Toast notifications provide operation feedback for all admin actions, with success confirmation on completed operations and error details on failures. Optimistic UI updates provide immediate visual feedback while server requests complete in the background.

Animation variants are defined in dedicated JavaScript files under the animations directory, organized by animation type. Core variant collections include fadeIn with configurable directional variants for up, down, left, and right entrance directions, staggerChildren for sequenced parent-child timing animations, and scaleOnHover for interactive element feedback.

SlideIn variants provide page transition effects when navigating between routes. TextReveal enables character-by-character text animation for dramatic headline presentation. Each variant file exports named variant objects with defined duration, easing curves, and stagger delay configurations.

Page transitions use AnimatePresence wrapping the router Outlet with combined fade and slide variants for smooth navigation between pages. Section reveals use whileInView with configurable threshold values and once:true for performance optimization. The reduced-motion query support respects user accessibility preferences through prefers-reduced-motion media query detection.

The useSmoothScroll custom hook initializes the Lenis smooth scrolling library on application mount, providing fluid scrolling behavior across all pages. It synchronizes Lenis with Framer Motion's useAnimationFrame for optimized performance and integrated scroll-driven animations.

Configuration options include wheel multiplier for scroll speed control, touch inertia for mobile momentum scrolling, and breakpoint-based disabling for accessibility and performance on lower-end devices. The smooth scroll enhances the browsing experience on long content pages.

The Lenis integration provides configurable lerp values for scroll feel and easing curves for natural scroll deceleration. This creates a polished, professional scrolling experience that differentiates the platform from standard browser scrolling.

Tailwind CSS dark mode uses the class strategy, allowing programmatic theme switching via the ThemeProvider. The provider toggles the dark class on the HTML element, triggering Tailwind's dark variant selectors throughout the stylesheets.

CSS custom properties defined in global.css provide consistent color tokens for both light and dark modes. Light mode variables define white backgrounds, gray text, and green accents. Dark mode variables define dark backgrounds, light text, and lighter green accents for contrast.

The responsive design system uses mobile-first breakpoints including sm at 640px for mobile landscape, md at 768px for tablet portrait, lg at 1024px for tablet landscape and desktop, and xl at 1280px for large desktop displays. Navigation collapses to hamburger below lg, grid layouts reflow from 4-column to 2-column to single-column, and typography scales down on smaller screens.
